_comment: Quality targets agreed for v2 (docs/ROADMAP.md, D25). `python -m src.eval run` checks the detection targets on the deployed verdict at the auto-report operating point, overall and for every brand in the split; `python -m src.eval ops` checks the pipeline medians. A target with too little data is `not_resolvable`, never met. brand_overrides replaces thresholds for one brand, e.g. {"bancolombia": {"recall": {"min": 0.9}}}.
